scope: Actual generated SQL in Node SQLite, real Request/Response/WebCrypto, D1 API adapter; no deployed database or live SIWC asserted.

results.name: Strict portable contract, field bounds, real dates and public-reference URLs
Every administrator operation checks SIWC identity and explicit allowlist
HMAC form token, origin, expiry and absent configuration fail closed
Receipt follows persisted SQLite row; identical retry returns the same receipt
Changed body under the same request ID is rejected without overwriting
Ambiguous response after commit is recovered by an identical retry
An actual SQL insert failure never returns a successful receipt
Concurrent duplicate submissions produce one row and one winning receipt
Concurrent rate limiting is atomic, bounded and stores no raw network address
Malformed JSON, non-JSON media and oversized streaming bodies are rejected
Contact correction preserves creation hash, notice version and initial retry receipt
Two administrators editing one revision cannot overwrite the winner
Export is portable and checksum-verified; changed contents are rejected
Deletion removes all customer payload and blocks stale public retries
Failed deletion transaction leaves original row and no false tombstone
Deleted or stale records cannot be exported or silently updated
Administrative pagination is bounded, stable and excludes full contact payloads
A client already limited cannot exhaust the shared allowance for other visitors
